name: Smoke Tests - Mastodon

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - next
      - '*.*-maintenance'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  smoke-mastodon:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build Fedify Test Harness
        run: npm run build

      - name: Setup Deno
        uses: denoland/setup-deno@v1
        with:
          deno-version: v1.x

      - name: Start Mastodon Stack and Fedify Harness
        run: |
          cd test/smoke/mastodon
          # Ensure environment variables are set for Mastodon
          export LOCAL_DOMAIN=localhost
          export SECRET_KEY_BASE=$(openssl rand -hex 64)
          export OTP_SECRET=$(openssl rand -hex 64)
          export VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY=$(openssl genpkey -algorithm EC -pkeyopt ec_paramgen_curve:P-256 -outform PEM 2>/dev/null | openssl pkey -in - -outform DER | base64 | tr -d '\n')
          
          # Start the stack using docker-compose
          docker compose up -d postgres redis
          
          # Wait for DB and Redis to be ready
          sleep 5
          
          # Run Mastodon setup commands if necessary
          docker compose run --rm web bundle exec rails db:migrate
          docker compose run --rm web bundle exec rails assets:precompile
          
          # Start the web and sidekiq services
          docker compose up -d web sidekiq
          
          # Wait for services to be healthy
          sleep 10

      - name: Run Smoke Tests
        run: |
          cd test/smoke
          deno run --allow-net --allow-read --allow-env orchestrator.ts

      - name: Stop Services
        if: always()
        run: |
          cd test/smoke/mastodon
          docker compose down -v

      - name: Upload Logs on Failure
        if: failure()
        run: |
          cd test/smoke/mastodon
          docker compose logs > mastodon-logs.txt
          mkdir -p logs
          mv mastodon-logs.txt logs/
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Upload Logs Artifact
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: mastodon-smoke-logs
          path: test/smoke/mastodon/logs/
